quick.title: First steps
quick.intro: GreenVale mixes exploration, farming, and combat. This short guide helps you get started without opening the full manual.
quick.move: Move with WASD or the arrow keys.
quick.inventory: Press E to open the inventory and swap tools.
quick.interact: Use F to interact with shops, objects, and special areas.
quick.footer: For more details, open the full manual with the button beside it.

manual.title: User manual
manual.intro: Here is the essentials to get started. The manual follows the language chosen in settings.

keys.title: Keys and shortcuts
keys.subtitle: These are the main actions you will use during the game.
keys.move: Move the character around the map.
keys.slots: Quickly switch between the 8 inventory slots.
keys.interact: Interact with objects, shops, and map areas.
keys.save: Save, export, and load the game.

controls.title: Movement and actions
controls.text: Use the arrow keys or WASD to move around and interact with the world.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.text: Organize items, choose tools, and manage what you collected during the game.

shop.title: Shops
shop.text: Buy tools, upgrades, and skins. Purchased skins are saved for later.

save.title: Saving and export
save.text: Progress is saved automatically in the browser and can also be exported as JSON.

tips.sync: Skins and save data stay synchronized with the exported file.
tips.newGame: New game restores the base inventory and clears saved progress.

story.title: How to play, step by step
story.intro: Follow this order to quickly understand the game. Later you can replace each block with your own gameplay screenshots.

step1.title: 1. Visit the Hardware Shop
step1.text: Start by learning the Hardware Shop. This is where you find basic tools, buckets, and other important starter items.

step2.title: 2. Buy your seed
step2.text: Next go to the Seeds Shop and choose the crop you want to grow. Seeds are the starting point of your production.

step3.title: 3. Plant, water, and watch
step3.text: Use the right tool in the field, plant the seed, and water when needed. The crop will grow until it is ready.

step4.title: 4. Harvest, sell, and improve
step4.text: When the crop is ready, harvest it and sell the result. Use coins and boss tokens to buy upgrades, skins, and progression.
